scope: Timestamped public source and price observations only. No live transaction preparation, gas estimation, signing, broadcasting, credentials or price-collector implementation.
useRestriction: Historical observations, not approved rates, a purchase quote, current defaults or a live fee-eligibility decision. Obtain fresh source observations before any separately approved purchase.
quoteConvention: One test USDC is one nominal quote-dollar; test tokens have no monetary backing and testnet economics do not establish production viability.

chainlink.provenanceVerification: The official directory HTML embeds the Sepolia reference-data URL and the exact proxy/heartbeat/decimals entries. Those rows were independently retrieved from the referenced JSON. Only the relevant bounded fields are retained here.

proposedPolicy.status: Proposal for Task 03D, not a live collector or an approved quote
proposedPolicy.expiryRule: Rate expiration must be no later than updatedAt plus 3600 seconds; quote/payment authorization must not outlive any required rate.
proposedPolicy.validation: Require exact approved proxy, expected description/decimals, positive bounded answer, nonzero valid round/update timestamps and a canonical observation block. Reject future or stale updates.
proposedPolicy.missedHeartbeatBehavior: Stop new payment authorization; no silent grace period or alternate-price substitution.
proposedPolicy.limitation: A heartbeat is an update trigger, not an uptime guarantee. ETH was near its documented heartbeat in this historical sample. Task 03D still needs fresh reads, a trusted clock and explicit policy integration.

nearUsd.status: Disabled discovery candidate pending approved Task 03D source/freshness policy and collector
nearUsd.accessCaveat: General official rate-limit documentation describes keyless IP-based access, and the observed request succeeded without credentials. The endpoint's Demo reference nevertheless marks its API-key header required. Neither documentation nor one successful response establishes future endpoint availability or an uptime guarantee. No API account or key was created, requested or read.
nearUsd.proposedValidation: Bind the exact coin ID and USD quote. Preserve and parse the raw decimal lexeme into integer numerator/denominator; never calculate from binary floating point. Require last_updated_at, reject future/stale timestamps and unavailable, malformed or unauthorized responses. Do not retry into a silent pass.

requiredFields: positive rational USD numerator and denominator
public source URL and original observation reference
demonstrationRateAlternative.restrictions: No unstated rates, price substitutions or reuse of expired observations. Preserve the separate 60-second fee-estimate freshness gate and the configured 1000-bps total expected system execution fee threshold. A verified price source alone does not establish fee eligibility.
